what: Pressing the BOOK NOW pill floating at the bottom right makes the corners go from pill to .5rem squared over .4s while width and height expand to the panel size (the text shrinks to .8x and moves left), and the booking row inside the panel turns on at .2s. Pressing again or pressing outside folds it back over the same length. It hides over .3s while scrolling and returns when scrolling stops. When collapsed, hovering inverts the background and text color.

options.dur: Open and close duration (seconds), default .4 — shorten for places opened often like an app
options.hide: none means it doesn’t hide even while scrolling — default is hidden (in the original, Lenis adds html.lenis-scrolling during scroll)
options.rest: Time until it reappears after scrolling stops (seconds), default .15
options.--fx-w · --fx-h · --fx-open-w · --fx-ope: (css variable) collapsed pill · expanded panel size · expanded corner, defaults 11.625rem · 3.875rem · 16.375rem · 8.1875rem · .5rem
options.--fx-fill · --fx-ink · --fx-right · --fx: (css variable) panel color (default accent) · text color · position
options.[data-fx-part=title]: (If present) pill text — shrinks to .8x and moves left as it expands
options.[data-fx-part=close]: (optional) × at top right of the opened panel — turns on once opened
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: (If present) content inside the expanded panel
